entries.message: Fix - Sync activity retries resolve in place and dashboard posters stop flickering
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Retrying a failed or skipped sync item now updates its status in place instead of leaving a stale duplicate error entry behind - it shows success, or skipped when there's nothing configured to sync to, instead of staying stuck as failed forever

Added a Retry all failed action on the Sync Activity page that retries every failed or skipped item across the whole history, not just the current page, as a background job that keeps running even if you close the tab or navigate away
Fixed the Sync Activity Retry failed button giving no visible feedback when a retry finished or failed
Fixed unconfigured media servers being dispatched to and reported as errors instead of being skipped the same way a disabled server already is
Fixed dashboard posters flickering and reloading in the Continue Watching row whenever a playing item's resume progress updated
